title: Canonical integral internal Hom reduction comparison
statement:
Fix a finite-field datum $D$ of characteristic $p$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], a prime $\ell\ne p$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with ring of integers $R$ and uniformizer $\varpi$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], a scheme $X$, and an integer $n\ge1$. On the small pro-etale site let $\widehat R_X=\varprojlim_m(R/\varpi^m)_X$, with projection to $(A_n)_X$, where $A_n=R/\varpi^n$ [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients]. Let $F_n$ be derived reduction [def-weil-integral-derived-reduction], and let $H_R,H_n$ be the ambient derived internal Homs over these two coefficient sheaves [def-pur-derived-internal-hom]. For $K,L\in D(X_{\mathrm{proet}},\widehat R_X)$, define the canonical comparison
$$F_n H_R(K,L)\longrightarrow H_n(F_nK,F_nL)$$
as the tensor-Hom transpose of
$$F_n H_R(K,L)\otimes^{\mathbf L}_{A_n}F_nK\longrightarrow F_n(H_R(K,L)\otimes^{\mathbf L}_{\widehat R_X}K)\longrightarrow F_nL.$$
The first arrow is the inverse canonical scalar tensor comparison and the second is reduced evaluation. The tensor models are localizations of the signed direct-sum total sheaf tensor on K-flat representatives [def-pc-kflat-complex] [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. Their adjunctions to the fixed K-injective Hom are normalized by the Hom-complex equation $f(x\otimes y)=c(x)(y)$ on every localized section [def-pur-hom-complex]. The ordinary scalar-extension unit is $x\mapsto1\otimes x$, with sheafification and the recorded change-of-rings object identification [lem-weil-integral-reduction-tower-well-defined]. Its total tensor comparison sends the unit image of $x\otimes y$ to the tensor of the two unit images. The derived tensor comparison is the unique natural isomorphism satisfying the left-derived counit square on all pairs of K-flat representatives. These normalized models and adjunctions exist and determine the displayed map independently of their unique compatible model isomorphisms. Invertibility of the Hom comparison is a separate assertion. The product projections used in this normalization are selected from the product-limit, signed-differential and componentwise-functoriality proposition for the already selected Hom-complex functor of [def-pur-hom-complex]. This is the recorded proposition [lem-sc-hom-complex-projections], obtained by applying choice specification to that functor-existence theorem; proof irrelevance preserves the selected family.

proof.text: Choose the normalized coefficient closed and K-flat models and their scalar tensor comparison from scalarInternalHomAdjunction_exists.

Construct HomReductionTensorModel from these models: inverse transpose gives currying; closed evaluation naturality gives its naturality equation; the componentwise cochain currying theorem supplies the unique chain map; the fixed augmentation normalization gives the representative equation.

Identify the ordinary extension functor with integralReductionChangeOfRings using the recorded object and morphism equations. Transport the normalized scalar tensor comparison to integralDerivedReduction with its prescribed universal counit. The ordinary unit and pure-tensor formulas become integralTowerTensorSection formulas, and the quotient factorization natural isomorphism is the identity on complexes, so the transported counit square is exactly the required normalization.
